summary: Customer handles a petroleum stream and currently uses laboratory water determination. They want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process, with the analyzer outside the process area, so changes are noticed sooner. They ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
